title: Los Cabos Luxury Sunset Sail with Light Appetizers and Open Bar
overview: Sail past spectacular seaside sights at sunset on a romantic cruise from Los Cabos. Sip drinks from the open bar and nibble on light bites from a gourmet menu as you cruise past iconic landmarks like the Los Cabos Arch and Lover’s Beach. Watch as the sun sinks into the crystalline water and enjoy the luxurious facilities of your vessel. Get personalized attention from your crew on this small-group tour.
inclusions: Hotel pickup from listed Los Cabos hotels
startDescription: Hotel pickup is confirmed at booking for listed Los Cabos hotels. Look for a white Cabo Adventures van.

title: Luxury Catamaran Whale Watching Cabo San Lucas
overview: Increase your chances of humpback whales in the wild during a luxury whale-watching tour by catamaran from Cabo San Lucas. As well as enjoying views of the Cabo San Lucas coastline from the top deck of the double-decker boat, you’ll benefit from the expert knowledge of a guide. Plus, alcoholic and soft drinks, and snacks are included.
startDescription: Hotel pickup can be added for a listed fee. A $2 dock fee per person is collected at check-in.

title: Humpback Whales in Cabo San Lucas
overview: When in Cabo San Lucas, don’t miss the chance to see humpback whales and other dramatic marine life on this boat tour. Accompanied by a marine biologist onboard, see whales making gigantic splashes. Snap shots of the iconic Arch of Cabo San Lucas and its sea lion colony. This small-group tour is limited to 12 passengers, ensuring personalized attention and maximizing your sighting chances.
startDescription: Meet at CaboTrek inside Hotel Tesoro, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 20-Local A, near dock M-O.

title: Cabo San Lucas Sunset Sailing Shared Cruise
overview: Set out on a relaxing and informative sunset sailing cruise off Los Cabos. Board a luxury yacht for a 2-hour evening excursion, watching the sun slowly disappear below the horizon while listening to music and enjoying an array of drinks and appetizers. An expert crew will regale you with facts and history about the area as your boat makes its way smoothly across the sea.
inclusions: Unlimited beer, wine and soft drinks
startDescription: Meet at the Cabo San Lucas marina dock listed when booking. Hotel pickup is not included.

title: Half Day Cabo Snorkel Adventure with Lunch and Open Bar
overview: Join a guided two-bay snorkel from Cabo San Lucas with lunch and an open bar on board. The published route covers calm corridor bays and a Land’s End pass for the Arch, with crew handling gear, food service, and in-water timing.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is confirmed at booking for listed Los Cabos hotels.

title: Cabo San Lucas and Santa Maria Bay Snorkeling Sightseeing Cruise
overview: Cruise from Cabo San Lucas toward Santa Maria Bay for a guided snorkel and sightseeing outing. The boat covers corridor water and reef time with gear on board, then returns to the marina after the published swim window.
startDescription: Meet at the Cabo San Lucas marina location listed when booking.

title: Cabo San Lucas Glass Bottom Kayak Tour and Snorkel at Two Bays
overview: Visit some of Cabo’s most spectacular snorkeling spots on this affordable excursion. After a convenient hotel pickup, head to Santa María and Chileno Bays with a bilingual guide. Travel by air-conditioned van and double-seated kayak equipped with a dry bag for valuables. Get outfitted with snorkeling gear, a life jacket, and a wetsuit (if needed) and experience the bay’s subtropical fish, incredible coral reefs, and dramatic rock formations.
startDescription: Hotel pickup starts about 90 minutes before the activity time based on the listed hotel.

title: Todos Santos Day Trip from Cabo San Lucas
overview: Visit Todos Santos, a community of thriving artisans, on this day trip from Los Cabos. Travel along the Pacific Coast to the eclectic little town situated near the southern tip of the Baja Peninsula. You’ll stop by a variety of art galleries and shops, enjoy a tequila tasting, and sit down for lunch at the Hotel California. Numbers are limited to ensure personalized attention from your professional guide.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is included from listed Los Cabos hotels and confirmed at booking.

title: Best ATV Cabo Adventure, Desert & Beach Ride whit Tequila Tasting
overview: Get your adrenaline pumping as you explore the desert and Migriño Beach on your own ATV. This group tour from Cabo takes you on an adventure along the Pacific Ocean and over sand dunes, offering plenty of opportunities to enjoy the views and observe nature. Suitable for cruise ship passengers and includes round-trip transfers from your hotel, villa, or the cruise port.
startDescription: Hotel, villa, Airbnb, or cruise-port pickup is included from listed Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo points.

title: Cabo San Lucas Private Yacht Cruise with Open Bar
overview: Explore the Cabo waters in style—in the company of just your friends or family—on this private yacht cruise. Soak up the views as you sail then jump off board at Pelican Rock, a favorite snorkel spot; admire the famed El Arco de Cabo San Lucas, and go snorkeling or paddleboarding at Chileno Bay Los Cabos, one of Cabo's most beautiful bays. Drinks and snacks included.
startDescription: Meet at Local A Tesoro Hotel, Blvd. Paseo de la Marina 20, Centro, Marina, Cabo San Lucas.

title: Sunset Cruise in Los Cabos with Jazz and Wine
overview: Listen to smooth jazz while sampling canapés and wine aboard the Tropicat, an elegant catamaran. This jazz cruise departs Cabo San Lucas in the early evening and features an open international bar. Glide into the sunset while you pass landmarks such as Lover's Beach and the Arch at Land's End. Your package includes transfers from most Los Cabos hotels.
inclusions: Unlimited beer, wine, premium liquor and soft drinks
startDescription: Hotel pickup from listed Los Cabos hotels must be reserved at least 48 hours before departure.

title: Beach Hopper Small-Group Snorkeling Tour in Los Cabos
overview: Visit two of the best snorkeling sites along the Sea of Cortez on a 'Beach Hopper' snorkeling tour of both Chileno Bay and Santa Maria Bay. Depart Los Cabos for a zodiac ride to each destination, where you'll spend a half-hour at a time swimming and snorkeling alongside manta rays, sea turtles and scores of brightly colored fish. Afterward pay a visit to secluded Lovers Beach to enjoy a bit of sun-infused downtime, followed by a light lunch and a trip to see El Arco and the local sea lions.
startDescription: Meet at the Los Cabos departure listed when booking.

title: Hike the native Pericu road in Sierra de la Laguna.
overview: Discover the tracks, trails and ways of life of Cabo’s indigenous nomadic people, the Pericu, on a guided hike through the Sierra de la Laguna mountains, with convenient hotel transfers. Meet a true California rancho for a traditional meal, including handmade tortillas and rancho cheese. Then hike 4 miles (6 kilometers) through the nature reserve, learning about the flora and fauna of semitropical desert and how the Pericu lived.
startDescription: Meet at the McDonald's parking lot on Blvd. Lázaro Cárdenas, El Medano Ejidal, or request hotel pickup.

title: Explore Los Cabos City Tour, Glass-Bottom Boat Ride, Lunch and Shopping!
overview: This guided Los Cabos day combines a glass-bottom boat ride to the Arch with a narrated city circuit, artisan stops, and a sit-down lunch window. The published route keeps the group on marina, Arch, and downtown stops rather than a self-drive shopping loop.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is included from listed Los Cabos hotels and confirmed at booking.
